_help: Read by tools/build-gear.py. Items a character gets without a quest (bought or crafted), per character id: step = the guide step's exact title, id = one item, ids = a choice (the best one is worn), from = what the tooltip says. Quest rewards come from WoW: Forever's QuestieDB, so they don't go here.
